text:
maria: Heads-up — I just opened a set of 6 PRs that bulk-move and rename the SDK snippets and the migration guide. They're dependent on each other, so we need a merge order to avoid broken anchors in the published site.

kevin: Can you paste the PR list and which should go first?

maria: Sure — short list:
- PR #7428: rename SDK snippets directory (moves files and updates references)
- PR #7429: update migration-guide anchors and examples (references new snippet paths)
- PR #7430: add redirects for old snippet paths -> new paths (Netlify _redirects)
- PR #7431: docs nav reorder (tiny toc change)
- PR #7432: fix embed examples in quickstart (point to renamed snippets)
- PR #7433: CI/docs preview config tweak (ensure preview builds handle redirects)

ashley: If redirects go after renames, the site might serve 404s for a bit. I usually merge redirect PR first so old URLs keep working while content updates land behind them.

dan: That can work, but redirects rely on the new paths existing for the target. If the rename hasn't merged yet, redirect targets will 404. Netlify redirects don't check targets at deploy time.

kevin: So we have a chicken-and-egg. My recommendation: create redirect rules that map old -> temporary-holder path, merge them, then merge renames and update redirects to final targets in a quick follow-up. But we don't have time for two rounds.

maria: Alternative: merge renames and migration-guide together in the same window (they're PR7428 + PR7429), then immediately merge redirects (PR7430) and the small follow-ups. That minimizes the outage window.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #7428 (preview link: https://deploy-preview-7428--docs.redwood.dev)

ashley: We need reviewers lined up — @kevin can you review PR7428 and PR7429? @ashley can take the nav reorder + quickstart fixes?

kevin: Yep I can review 7428/7429. ETA ~2 hours.

ashley: I'll queue 7431 and 7432. Quick note: 7432 touches code fences with language hints — CI lint sometimes flags triple-backtick spacing.

maria: CI preview for PR7429 is failing with "Broken anchor: #client-auth" in migration-guide. I think the anchor generated changed when the snippet filename changed.

kevin: Can you paste the failing line?

maria: "See the client auth section for token rotation (#client-auth)" — after rename the header id became "client-token-auth".

dan: We should add a short pre-merge checklist in the PRs: 1) docs-preview green; 2) linkcheck run locally (tools/link-checker); 3) redirect rules included if path changes; 4) mention reviewers and merge window.

maria: Agreed. Also propose we pick a 30-min merge window during low traffic (US morning) and have one person merge in this order: 7428 -> 7429 -> 7430 -> 7432 -> 7431 -> 7433. That keeps broken anchors window to minutes.

kevin: Sounds reasonable. I can be on merge duty at 11:00 PT. Maria, can you rebase 7429 so preview will be accurate?

maria: Rebased and pushed. Preview for 7429 is now: https://deploy-preview-7429--docs.redwood.dev — please spot-check anchors.

ashley: Quick spot: on the migration guide, the header looks like:
```
### Client token auth
```
so the anchor is "client-token-auth" by our markdown renderer. Update internal link to that.

kevin: I'll update my review comments on 7429 to point that out. Also we should add a small automated link-check step in the PR template to run `npx linkinator` against the preview URL.

maria: Good call. I've added a checklist item and a short snippet to PR template in 7433:
```
- Run: npx linkinator https://deploy-preview-<PR>--docs.redwood.dev -i 200 -r 2
```

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #7429 build is now passing.

kevin: Reviewing 7428 now. One nit about import paths but otherwise LGTM. I'll approve and hold merge until the window.

ashley: I've approved 7432 and 7431; left a tiny spacing nit on 7432 which I'll fix after merge.

maria: Final plan: kevin merges 7428 then 7429 back-to-back at 11:00 PT, then 7430 (redirects) immediately after. I'll watch the live site and roll back if any major breakage. If linkinator finds failures, we pause and revert the last merge.

dan: Can we add a smoke-check script to quickly verify a handful of critical anchors after merges? I can run a small script that fetches a list of URLs and checks 200 + anchor presence.

maria: Yes please — put it in this thread when ready. Also tagging @product if they want to avoid a merge during planned docs announcements tomorrow.

kevin: All set. See you at 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
